publisher: 北京互联网法院 · 澎湃号政务 / Beijing Internet Court via The Paper
originalTitle: e案e审丨短剧角色AI换脸“神似”知名演员，是偶然“撞脸”还是故意侵权？
byline: 北京互联网法院；供稿：叶含妍、何南骏
headline: A familiar face. No permission.
zhHeadline:
短剧里出现了她的脸，
她却没有参演
deck: A court found that a short drama’s producer and distributor infringed an actor’s likeness rights.
zhDeck: 北京互联网法院认定，短剧制作方与播出方均侵害了演员的肖像权。

sections.heading: Recognisable after a swap
sections.text: The producer argued that AI had coincidentally created a similar face. The court rejected that account and found the actor recognisable in two clips.
sections.zhText: 制作方辩称，AI生成的形象只是偶然“撞脸”。法院未采信这一解释，认定两个片段中的形象能够被公众识别为该演员。

sections.heading: Two separate permissions
sections.text: The distributor had a copyright licence for the drama. That did not clear the actor’s likeness rights. Both companies were ordered to apologise and pay damages; neither appealed.
sections.zhText: 播出方取得了短剧的著作权许可，但这不能替代演员的肖像授权。两家公司分别被判致歉并赔偿，双方均未上诉。

factLabel: companies held liable in two related cases
zhFactLabel: 家公司在关联案件中被认定侵权
question: Who agreed to this appearance?
zhQuestion: 这个新角色，经过谁的同意？

originalTitle: In China, people are renting out their faces to AI
headline: Your face, available for licence.
zhHeadline:
你的脸，
也能成为授权素材
deck: Rest of World reports on Chinese platforms licensing likenesses for AI dramas, games and advertising.
zhDeck: Rest of World报道，中国平台正撮合肖像授权，用于AI短剧、游戏和广告。

sections.heading: A catalogue of people
sections.text: Producers can browse faces and agree permitted uses. ActID told reporters it charged 99–500 yuan per episode and took a 10% commission.
sections.zhText: 制作方可以浏览面孔、约定用途。ActID向记者表示，每集授权费为99至500元，平台抽成10%。

sections.heading: Control after upload
sections.text: Lawyer Yile Deng warned that vague terms can leave people unsure who will use their likeness and for what. Licensing platforms cannot remove every risk of reuse or misuse.
sections.zhText: 律师邓轶乐提醒，模糊的条款会让授权人无法确定最终使用者和用途。授权平台也无法消除全部二次使用及滥用风险。

factLabel: per episode, according to ActID in this report
zhFactLabel: 每集授权费，来自报道中的ActID说法
question: Does a fee make the future use clear?
zhQuestion: 收到授权费，就知道脸会被用到哪里了吗？

publisher: 每日经济新闻，经极目新闻转载 / National Business Daily via Jimu News
originalTitle: AI时代，真人脸更值钱了！一位银行职员3天“卖脸”7次，收入2500元！交易平台谈赚钱逻辑：AI脸已审美疲劳，素人脸可能更有机会
byline: 每日经济新闻；极目新闻转载
headline: One face. Seven licences.
zhHeadline:
同一张脸，
三天被授权七次
deck: A platform founder described a bank employee earning nearly 2,500 yuan after commission.
zhDeck: 报道引述平台创始人的案例：一名银行职员三天内授权七次，扣除抽成后收入近2500元。

sections.heading: A reported example
sections.zhHeading: 个案收入，不是收益承诺
sections.text: New Claw’s founder said one company licensed the face seven times, at 500 yuan each. These are platform statements reported by the newspaper, not guaranteed earnings.
sections.zhText: 新爪创始人称，同一家公司七次购买该面孔的授权，每次500元。这是报道中的平台说法，不是普通用户收入或收益保证。

sections.heading: A project, not a buyout
sections.text: The report describes project-based licensing and a 30% platform fee. Lawyer Wang Guangying cautioned that permission for source material does not automatically permit AI training.
sections.zhText: 报道介绍了按项目授权与30%的平台服务费。律师王光英提醒，素材授权不等于训练授权。用于一部短剧，也不代表可以继续用于其他作品。

factLabel: licences in three days, according to the platform founder
zhFactLabel: 次授权／三天，来自平台创始人的个案说法
question: How many new uses can one face acquire?
zhQuestion: 同一张脸，可以被分成多少次用途？

originalTitle: People trust AI fake faces more than real ones, according to a new study
byline: Victoria Masterson；研究：Sophie Nightingale & Hany Farid
headline: A face can look trustworthy. Is it?
zhHeadline:
看起来值得信任，
就真的可信吗？
deck: A 2022 study found higher average trustworthiness ratings for its AI-generated faces.
zhDeck: 一项2022年的研究发现，实验所用AI合成人脸获得了更高的平均可信度评分。

sections.heading: An experimental result
sections.text: The Forum reported a 7.7% higher average rating for synthetic faces in research by Sophie Nightingale and Hany Farid, published in PNAS.
sections.zhText: 世界经济论坛介绍，Nightingale与Farid发表于PNAS的研究中，合成人脸的平均可信度评分高出7.7%。

sections.heading: Appearance is not evidence
sections.text: This measures judgements of images, not actual honesty, identity or commercial value. The result concerns the study’s images and participants, not every AI face.
sections.zhText: 这测量的是人们对图像的判断，不能证明实际诚实程度、身份真实性或商业价值。结论限于研究中的图像与受试者，不能推广到所有AI面孔。

factLabel: average perceived trustworthiness in this experiment
zhFactLabel: 实验中的平均感知可信度评分差异
question: What makes a face feel convincing?
zhQuestion: 什么让一张脸显得可信？

extraSources.label: PNAS · original study / 原始研究
